Game Overview

At its heart, Monster Demolition Giants 3D is a car game about drive a war car through a city overrun by colossal monsters in an exhilarating clash of speed and destruction. Crush giant foes, collect coins, and upgrade to fierce machines like tanks and robots. Navigate obstacles strategically and dominate an ever-escalating battlefield, unleashing unparalleled mayhem.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Monster Demolition Giants 3D is easy to pick up. Drive a war car through a city overrun by colossal monsters in an exhilarating clash of speed and destruction.
